item.title: Artificial-life: A simple (300 lines of code) reproduction of Computational Life
item.description:
📝 Every iteration, neighboring programs are randomly paired, have their instruction tapes concattenated together, and are run for a maximum of $2^{13}$ steps. The instructions are such that they can loop and mutate the instruction tapes (programs) themselves. As found in the paper, self-replicating programs that copy themselves over their neighbor's tape often spontaneously emerge, which soon spread to take over the entire grid.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/Rabrg/artificial-life

item.title: Ask HN: Please restrict new accounts from posting
item.description:
📝 I don’t know if I’m the only one, but I see lots of clearly AI generated posts recently in HN and mostly coming from new accounts (green), it is more noticeable in the Show HN section. I wish the team can either restrict new accounts from posting or at least offer a default filtering where I can only see posts from accounts with certain criteria. I don’t want to see HN becoming twitter, which is full of bots and noise, as this would be a really sad day.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47300329
